title: Compatible-triangle word for the geometric semilinear compositor
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes. On a small representative of $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ put $B_{n,W}=(A_n)_W$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathscr S_W$ consist of $B_{n,W}$-module sheaves with semilinear quotient transitions and compatible componentwise morphisms. Use $D(\mathscr S_W)$ and the simultaneous geometric section models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Write $P_u=u^*$, $R_u=Ru_*$, with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$ of $P_u\dashv R_u$, and $J_j=j_!$ for exact open extension. All maps below are actual derived-system maps with their quotient transitions.

Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type maps and choose a compactification $g=si$, with $i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y$ open and $s:\overline Y\to Z$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. There exists a compatible triangle
$$X\xrightarrow{j}V\xrightarrow{b_1}\overline X,\qquad q:V\to Y,\quad p_1:\overline X\to\overline Y,$$
with $j,b_1$ quasi-compact open, $q,p_1$ proper, $qj=f$, and $p_1b_1=iq$ Cartesian, i.e. $V\cong\overline X\times_{\overline Y}Y$ via $(b_1,q)$ [def-pc-fibre-product]; $(j,q)$ and $(b_1j,sp_1)$ compactify $f$ and $gf$ [lem-weil-pbc-compatible-compactification-triangle]. Put $F=R_qJ_j$, $G=R_sJ_i$, $H=R_{sp_1}J_{b_1j}$. Let $d:R_sR_{p_1}\cong R_{sp_1}$ and $e:J_{b_1}J_j\cong J_{b_1j}$ be the canonical derived direct-image and open compositors [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition, lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]. Let $\gamma_Q:J_iR_q\to R_{p_1}J_{b_1}$ be the intrinsic clopen-projection mate of [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting], for this Cartesian square. Define
$$\beta_Q=R_{sp_1}(e)\,d_{J_{b_1}J_j}\,R_s(\gamma_QJ_j):GF\longrightarrow H.$$
This is a natural isomorphism on systems whose levels have bounded constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. It is the geometric compact-support composition comparison constructed in the simultaneous section models: the construction by the proper/open square and the proper and open compositors is exactly this word as a system map. Its evaluation at $n$ is the specified finite compositor $\alpha_{g,f}$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition] in these compactifications, with the etale-origin witnesses supplied by [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin]. The assertion includes identity compactifications and empty opens. There is no uniform cohomological or Tor interval in $n$ in the domain.

proof.text: QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace and quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated applied to the structure maps give qcqs for X,Y,Z. Apply exists_compatible_compactification_triangle to f,g,d. Use V = pullback e.g d.i, XB = e.Z, b = pullback.fst, q = pullback.snd and p = e.g. Its projection equations give j q = f and, after associativity and j b = e.i, the required composite factorization. The open d.i is quasi-compact by Compactification.quasiCompact_openImmersion.

Finite type over the field makes X,Y,Z locally Noetherian; the previous compactness makes them Noetherian. Properness of d.g, e.g and q gives compactness and local Noetherianity of d.Z, e.Z and V by the same argument. At each separate positive coefficient level, use the scalar_origin proof helper of system proper/open invertibility: fixed-module constructibility gives finite lisse models, bounded derived descent gives a bounded-below etale object, and the fixed scalar equivalence transports its realization to the given level. The coefficient carrier is exactly C_n and the scalar is identity. This uses only the interval at that level.

Apply the finite-word evaluation lemma to this origin, the supplied Cartesian square and its commutativity proof. This is the claimed finite-level equation with exactly compositorFiniteSource, coherenceEtaleCompositor in the three supplied compactifications, and compositorFiniteTarget.

The right side of that equation is invertible: it is a functor applied to an isomorphism followed by the target support isomorphism. Cancel the invertible source support comparison to obtain invertibility of the evaluated system word. The system_isIso_of_evaluations proof helper from system proper/open invertibility identifies E_n followed by constant-tower level zero with the jointly conservative semilinear evaluations and detects invertibility. This detects only invertibility, never equality of system morphisms. Pair this result with the already obtained finite equations and existential geometric witnesses.
